vadsrijk.klassen.spec.schildridder.kort: Steady combos with your pillow sword. Catch hits on your Snuggle Shield, then strike back hard. Want to tank? The Tank branch sits right next to it in your skill tree.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.r_spec_schildridd: You chose Shield Knight at your first job advancement.
vadsrijk.klassen.spec.reuzenkussen.kort: Slow, huge sweeps that also hit everything around your target, and leaps that shake the ground. A club or fluff hammer feels extra good here.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.r_spec_reuzenkuss: You chose Giant Pillow at your first job advancement.
vadsrijk.klassen.spec.scherpschutter.kor: Long range and critical hits. Your arrows curve to the target, far shots hit harder, and your Snuggle Arrow becomes a charged shot.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.j_spec_scherpschu: You chose Sharpshooter at your first job advancement.
vadsrijk.klassen.spec.strikkenzetter.kor: Quick shots, snares and fluff traps. You hold foes in place, make them sticky and wear them down over time. Strong against groups. Want to help your group? The Support branch sits next to it.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.j_spec_strikkenze: You chose Snare Setter at your first job advancement.
vadsrijk.klassen.spec.sterrenwever.kort: Elemental bursts: your Fireball leaves a puddle, every third spell is free, and later the ice shatters and the ground burns.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.m_spec_sterrenwev: You chose Star Weaver at your first job advancement.
vadsrijk.klassen.spec.zegenzanger.rol: Songs that hurt foes and help friends
vadsrijk.klassen.spec.zegenzanger.kort: You sing while you fight: your song makes you and your group stronger, and every 2 s a song pulse hits every foe around you. Want to heal? The Heal branch sits next to it.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.m_spec_zegenzange: You chose Blessing Singer at your first job advancement.
Your shield is your best friend.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.uitleg.schildridder: Double Smack: Pillow Bonk swings again (60 %). Counter: catch a hit with your Snuggle Shield and your next Pillow Bonk within 4 s does 50 % more.
Crystal Wall: while your Snuggle Shield is up, every foe that hits you freezes for 3 s. Pillow Bonk does 40 % more to frozen foes.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.kort.schildridder.2: Crystal Wall: shield freezes, +40 % vs frozen
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.uitleg.schildridder: Bulwark Flomp: Wahoog Flomp does 30 % more and stuns everything it hits for 2 s. Pillow Bonk does 15 % more.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.uitleg.reuzenkussen: Giant Sweep: your basic hits do 30 % more and also hit foes within 3 blocks of your target (50 %). Pillow Bonk does 60 % more but recharges 1 s slower.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.kort.reuzenkussen.1: Giant Sweep: swings that hit everything
The ground shakes when you land.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.uitleg.reuzenkussen: Pillow Roll: Storm Leap does 60 % more, is ready 2 s sooner and stuns what it hits for 1 s.
Nest Form: Wahoog Flomp does 30 % more and its wind pulls every foe within 8 blocks to the middle. Basic hits 10 % harder on top.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.onder.scherpschutte: One eye closed, one shot home.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.uitleg.scherpschutt: Falcon Gaze: your arrows curve a little to the target, +8 % crit chance and +15 % crit damage. Far shots: basic shots at foes further than 10 blocks do 30 % more.
Charged Arrow: your Snuggle Arrow does 80 % more damage to foes.
Canopy Falcon: Star Shot does 40 % more plus another quarter as true damage, right through shields. Basic shots 8 % harder.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.uitleg.strikkenzett: Flip Volley: in the middle of your Roll Flip you fire 3 arrows at the nearest foe. Snare: where you roll away, a trap stays for 6 s: whoever steps in sticks for 3 s and gets Spored (4 s of damage). Quick bow: 8 % attack speed.
Ice Star: every 5th basic shot that hits fires an ice star along (1x weapon damage, freezes 2 s). Star Shot freezes everything it pierces for 4 s.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.onder.strikkenzette: The whole field is your trap.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.uitleg.strikkenzett: Snare Rain: where Star Shot lands, a snare field lies for 5 s (radius 4): 40 % damage and Sticky every second. 8 % more attack speed.
The stars dance to your beat.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.uitleg.sterrenwever: Your Pink Fireball leaves an element puddle for 3 s. Chonk Overflow: every 3rd skill gives its energy back; +10 % cooldown reduction and +8 % element damage.
Ice that sings as it breaks.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.uitleg.sterrenwever: Mirror Echo: your Fireball freezes for 1.5 s; when it hits a foe that was already frozen, the ice shatters (1.2x damage, radius 3).
Where you cast, the ground glows.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.uitleg.sterrenwever: Dusk Sage: Meteor Guh leaves a pink fire field for 5 s (30 % damage + Burning every second). 8 % more element damage.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.kort.sterrenwever.3: Ult: fire field after Meteor Guh
Battle Song: you do 15 % more damage, your group within 10 blocks 8 % more. In a fight a song pulse hits every foe within 6 blocks every 2 s (50 % weapon damage).
Song Circle: your Chonk Spring sings along: for 6 s every foe inside takes 40 % weapon damage each second.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.kort.zegenzanger.2: Song Circle: Chonk Spring hurts foes
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.onder.zegenzanger.3: The final chord of the realm.
Final Chord: Meteor Guh does 30 % more and gives your group 8 s of Wahoog (+20 % damage).

vadsrijk.klassen.adv.klaar1: ✦ Your %s is level 17! Go to Grandmaster Chonkfoot in Shroomsbury to choose your specialization.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.klaar2: ✦ Your %s is level 35! In zone 3, Order Master Waxie awaits you in the Nest Chapel (after the Cheese Zeppelin Yard).
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.klaar3: ✦ Your %s is level 58! After Mother Cloudwhale's lullaby, Captain Springfeather awaits you in Highchonk.
vadsrijk.klassen.tak.stam.uitleg: For everyone in this class, whichever specialization you choose.
vadsrijk.klassen.tak.zij.knuffelridder.u: Optional: get tougher and protect your group.
vadsrijk.klassen.tak.zij.pluisjager.uitl: Optional: help your group with healing arrows, small shields and marks.
vadsrijk.klassen.tak.dicht_nog: First choose your specialization (class level 17, with the Grandmaster).
vadsrijk.klassen.tak.dicht_ander: This is the other specialization. You can switch in any town at the class master.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.r_schildarm.uitle: More Defense and some Strength. Your shield is practically glued on.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.r_vaste_hand.uitl: More crit chance and faster swings.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.r_schildmeester.u: Defense, Strength and crit in one.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.r_schildmuur.uitl: Lots of Defense and harder crits.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.r_onbreekbaar.uit: Every hit you catch on your Snuggle Shield makes Pillow Bonk ready 1 s sooner.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.r_reuzenkracht.ui: Lots of Strength and extra Chonk.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.r_reuzenplof.uitl: After Storm Leap your next Pillow Bonk (within 4 s) does 60 % more damage.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.r_paladijnsaura.u: Every 2 s you and your group within 10 blocks heal 1.5 % of their Chonk.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.j_sluipschutter.u: More crit chance and much harder crits.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.j_strikkenweb.uit: Your basic shots do 25 % more damage to Sticky foes.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.j_zorgzaam.uitleg: More Heal Power and extra Chonk.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.m_sterrenvonk.uit: More Element Damage and some Wisdom.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.m_koorkracht.uitl: Lots of Wisdom and extra Chonk.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.m_slotlied.uitleg: Your Battle Song gives you 5 % more damage and the song pulse reaches 2 blocks further.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.m_warme_handen.ui: More Heal Power and some Chonk.
vadsrijk.klassen.spec.onderkop: %s: two paths. Switch in any town at the class master (once per 10 minutes).
vadsrijk.klassen.spec.onderkop.kies: %s: choose your path! Both deal good damage, even solo.
vadsrijk.klassen.spec.word.tip: Your first job advancement: a new title, a new power and your own branch in the skill tree.
vadsrijk.klassen.spec.wissel.tip: Free. Your points in the old spec branch come back. Then wait 10 minutes.
vadsrijk.klassen.spec.later.tip: You choose your specialization with Grandmaster Chonkfoot in Shroomsbury once your class is level 17.
vadsrijk.klassen.spec.knop.tip: Look at both specializations of this class, or switch (once per 10 minutes, not in a fight).
vadsrijk.klassen.spec.gewisseld: ✦ You are now %s! Your points from the old branch are back.
vadsrijk.klassen.spec.migratie: ✦ The classes have been renewed! Your skill tree was rearranged: all your points are back (free). Your job advancements were converted to the new system. Take a look with K.
vadsrijk.klassen.spec.kies_nog: ✦ Your %s may still choose a specialization! Press K and click 'Choose your specialization'.
vadsrijk.klassen.spec.nee.al: You already have a specialization. Switch at the class master.
vadsrijk.klassen.spec.nee.nog_niet: You choose your specialization with Grandmaster Chonkfoot, at class level 17.
vadsrijk.klassen.spec.nee.balie: You can only switch in a town, at the class master.
vadsrijk.klassen.spec.nee.gevecht: Not in the middle of a fight! Wait until things calm down.
vadsrijk.klassen.spec.nee.arena: Not in a boss arena or dungeon.
vadsrijk.klassen.vergelijk.leeg: You're not wearing anything as %s yet:
vadsrijk.klassen.respec.klaar: Your skill tree is empty and your points are back. Choose again! (Resetting is always free.)
vadsrijk.klassen.scherm.ordetempel: You're always all three classes: attack with a different weapon to switch. Reset (always free) and switch your specialization at the class master in any town.
vadsrijk.klassen.scherm.respec.tip: All your points in this class back. Always free. Your specialization and advancements stay.
vadsrijk.klassen.scherm.adv.dicht: From level %s, through the class quest.
vadsrijk.klassen.tip.adv: Your class is ready for a job advancement! Check your quest log to see which class master is waiting for you.
